lidarc.title: LiDARC
lidarc.description:
This system provides an interactive platform for uploading, processing, and comparing
 pointcloud sets with a focus on efficient analysis and clear visual feedback. Users can 
 submit data through a web-based interface, trigger a comparison, and explore the resulting 
analyses through interactive visualizations. The system is designed to handle
computationally intensive tasks in the background, allowing users to continue working
without interruption while results are generated asynchronously. Created Results can be
viewed and additionally downloaded as a Report.
